title: NEARING THE END OF THE WILDERNESS

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: They left Hor Haggidgad and camped at Jotbathah. They left Jotbathah and camped at Abronah. They left Abronah and camped at Ezion Geber. They left Ezion Geber and camped at Kadesh, in the Desert of Zin. They left Kadesh and camped at Mount Hor, on the border of Edom. - Num 33:33-37 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The journey draws nearer to its goal. Jotbathah, Abronah, Ezion Geber, then Kadesh, then Mount Hor "on the border of Edom." After all the wandering, Israel was now approaching the edge of the Promised Land. The wilderness years were coming to a close. What had felt endless was, in God's timing, moving toward completion.

Kadesh was a significant place — it was here, years earlier, that Israel had refused to enter the land, and here that the wilderness wandering had begun. Now they pass through it again, but this time they keep moving forward. There is grace in that. The place of past failure need not be the place where we stay stuck. God brings His people back around and gives them the chance to move ahead in faith.

If you have known the frustration of a long, drawn-out season — a trial that seemed to have no end, a wait that stretched on and on — take encouragement here. God's wilderness seasons do have a border. They do not last forever. He is faithfully bringing His people to the edge of the promise, even when the middle of the journey felt like it would never end.

The greatest promise we await is not a piece of land but the eternal home Christ has prepared for us. Every hard season is temporary; the inheritance He secured for us is forever (1 Pet 1:4). The wilderness will end. Keep moving forward in faith, for the border of the promise is nearer than you think.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Are you passing through a place of past failure that God is calling you to move beyond?
2. How does knowing your wilderness season has a "border" encourage you?
3. What eternal promise in Christ keeps you moving forward?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You that my hardest seasons are not endless and that You are faithfully bringing me toward Your promise. Help me to move forward from places of past failure and to fix my hope on the eternal home Christ has prepared. Amen.
